name: Overpass residential buildings and POI amenity overlays

scenarios.prompt: Show residential buildings around the Colosseum, Rome, Italy.
Show nearby pharmacies around Bologna, Italy.
Show nearby pharmacies within 5 kilometers of latitude 25, longitude 13.

fixes.summary: Honor provider-declared circle coverage (type=circle, center, radius_m) as the authoritative spatial scope for radius-bounded vector results, instead of the narrow geocoder bbox intersection check that rejected POI/landmark "around <place>" renders.

remaining_limitation: Visibility mutation and remove/re-add lifecycle actions rely on the shared overlay-controls mechanism validated in T3-02/T3-06; the buildings/POI render, attribution, valid-empty, and acknowledgement boundaries are the new evidence recorded here. Overpass retains its documented partial general reliability; one transient provider timeout was observed on a re-attempt and recovered on retry.
